slots.notes: Fullscreen absolute-positioned looping hero background video, autoPlay + loop + muted + playsInline, object-cover so it fills the min-h-screen container without distortion behind all foreground content. The dark blue #21346e container color is only a pre-load fallback, so footage carries the entire backdrop.

Display sans-serif for the H1 headline and the CTA button label. Native value is the Google Font 'Rubik' (bold weight), rendered bold + uppercase; needs a sans-serif fallback. The headline relies on very tight leading (0.98) and negative letter-spacing (-2px to -4px), so a substitute must tolerate that condensed metric.

Inline SVG used as the CTA button background instead of a CSS fill: a single custom <path> filling the 184x65px button container (absolute inset-0), filled solid white, with the 'GET STARTED' label centered on top in dark (#161a20) text. Supply as a transparent-background single-color shape sized to the fixed 184x65 button box; the whole button scales on hover (scale-105) and press (scale-95).

mechanic: A top-aligned full-screen hero stacks a three-line bold uppercase Rubik headline and a fixed-size custom-SVG-backed 'GET STARTED' button over a fullscreen object-cover autoplay/loop/muted background video, with the only motion being the button's hover scale-up (scale-105) and active press (scale-95).
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS component spec (utility classes only, no extra libraries); native <video> element with autoPlay/loop/muted/playsInline for the background, and a hand-authored inline <svg><path> for the CTA button shape.
reskinNotes: The CTA button background is a hand-authored inline SVG <path> with white baked in as the fill attribute and dark #161a20 hardcoded on the label, so retinting the button means editing the SVG markup rather than a token, and the path is drawn for the fixed 184x65px box (any size or aspect change distorts the shape). The headline is split into three hardcoded lines ('NEW ERA' / 'OF DESIGN' / 'STARTS NOW') in markup, and its tight leading (0.98) plus negative letter-spacing (-2px to -4px) and the responsive text-6xl -> text-8xl -> text-[100px] ramp are tuned to Rubik bold and to three short lines, so longer copy or a substitute display font can rewrap or break the layout. The #21346e bg is only a fallback behind the video, not a themeable surface.
